captions.detailed: A desktop cube-shaped air purifier with a matte light-grey housing. The front face features a hinged access door with vertical ventilation slots and a contrasting black latch handle on its right side. On the left side of the housing, a louvered vent reveals a tan internal HEPA filter block. The access door swings open on a left-aligned vertical hinge (revolute joint), allowing the internal filter block to slide out horizontally (prismatic joint).
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a desktop cube-shaped air purifier. The main housing should have a side louvered vent showing a tan filter block, and the front should feature a hinged door with vertical ventilation slots and a black handle. Define a revolute joint for the door's hinge and a prismatic joint to allow the internal HEPA filter to slide out.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing as a hollowed-out box primitive with a side opening for louvers and a front opening for the door. Create the door using a thin box, subtract vertical slots for ventilation, and attach hinge cylinders and a black box handle. Model the internal HEPA filter block as a tan box with guide rails. Assemble the parts by defining a revolute joint along the door's left hinge axis and a prismatic joint along the filter's sliding axis.
